text: {"1630":{"about":["rustc_monomorphize"],"refers":[],"why":"Its mono-item collector adds statics as well as functions to the collected list."},"1631":{"about":[],"refers":["rustc_monomorphize"],"why":"This merely directs readers to documentation for the collector implemented by rustc_monomorphize."},"1632":{"about":["rustc_monomorphize","rustc_codegen_ssa"],"refers":[],"why":"Monomorphization collection is performed by rustc_monomorphize as part of the codegen pipeline initiated by rustc_codegen_ssa."},"1633":{"about":["rustc_codegen_ssa","rustc_monomorphize"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_codegen_ssa initiates collection through codegen_crate, while rustc_monomorphize collects and partitions mono items."},"1634":{"about":["rustc_monomorphize"],"refers":[],"why":"Its partitioning implementation creates stable and volatile codegen units to improve incremental compilation."}}
